messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: upgrading R or Apache
parts:
Something I have wondered for a while: When apache + R + rapache are
installed on a machine, and R or Apache is updated, should I also re-
compile and re-install RApache? Or can R binaries be updated without
affecting RApache?

Jeroen

messages.author: 832c709713595db0
messages.subject: Re: upgrading R or Apache
parts:
Jeroen wrote:
> Something I have wondered for a while: When apache + R + rapache are
> installed on a machine, and R or Apache is updated, should I also re-
> compile and re-install RApache? Or can R binaries be updated without
> affecting RApache?

You know, that's a good question. Theoretically, if no R data structures
were altered in a new R version, then the rapache library mod_R.so
should still be binary compatible.

But I still re-compile and re-install rapache after I 'apt-get update
r-*'. Yet another reason to create binary packages of rapache.

Jeff
